summary: Prologis, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a recommended offer under UK Rule 2.7 to acquire all of SEGRO plc, entering a Co-operation Agreement on August 4, 2026. Terms: SEGRO shareholders receive 0.0920 Prologis common shares per SEGRO share (stock consideration; price/share and premium not stated). No board recommendation or advisors named in the excerpt. The deal is structured as a UK scheme or offer subject to the City Code, with regulatory and shareholder approvals pending. Watch for offer document details, competition clearances, and any rival bid; risk-arb centers on share-ratio movement and closing timeline.
